Multiple Road Accidents Across India Result in Fatalities

Several road accidents have been reported across different regions of India, leading to multiple fatalities and injuries. Incidents involved collisions between buses, trucks, pickups, and cars, with some occurring on highways and others involving public transport. The accidents have resulted in deaths and left several individuals injured, prompting concern over road safety.
